verdict.rationale: A live probe found developer.calendly.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an explicit "Instructions for AI Agents" section. A second probe confirmed clean Markdown is served for any docs page by appending .md, with each page pointing back to the llms.txt index. Many cited doc pages are themselves served as .md, which corroborates agent-oriented docs across the developer site. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and no evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g. a full-content llms-full.txt variant).
